job.title: Store Manager
job.description:

job.title: QC Specialist-Biopharma
job.description:
QC Specialist

FRS Recruitment are delighted to be partnering with a biologics company in the Mid -West Region to recruit for a QC Specialist. As the QC Specialist you will be participating in and providing subject matter expertise in equipment qualification, method transfer and routine in-process and release testing within the QC labs, in addition to other QC-supporting activities.This is a great opportunity for an experienced Analytical QC professional that is keen to take a step into a unique role where they will work on a range of projects focused on manufacturing of biological products at early phase clinical trials.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Your duties as the QC Specialist will be varied however the key duties and responsibilities are as follows:

  • Participate in method validation and/ or technical transfer execution as needed.
  • Serve as a technical expert to develop, qualify, validate and troubleshoot HPLC, Capillary Electrophoresis, PCR and Cell culture assays.
  • You will ensure all aspects of QC work comply to GMP standards.
  • You will create and approve SOPs, report forms and specifications.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS:

To be successful in your application to this exciting opportunity as the QC Specialist we are looking to identify the following on your profile and work history:

  • Relevant degree in Biochemistry, Biological Sciences, Chemistry.
  • 5-6 years min industry experience working in a GMP biologics facility, specifically in a QC department.
  • Knowledge and practical experience with analytical assays such as HPLC, Capillary Electrophoresis and PCR.

Hours of work : Days only : 8.30am to 4.30pm Mon -Fri


What’s on offer:
• Flexible work pattern
• Yearly Bonuses
• Share Option Scheme
• Pension
• Enhanced annual leave days
• Medical Health care cover
• Dental cover
• Life Insurance
Interested? Apply today!

job.title: Health & Safety Manager
job.description:
Are you an experienced Health & Safety Manager with a strong manufacturing background looking for a role where you can lead site-wide safety and drive continuous improvement?

Our client, an established manufacturing organisation in Cork, is seeking a Health & Safety Manager to take full ownership of the site H&S function.

This is a standalone leadership role, offering the opportunity to work closely with senior management and operational teams to strengthen safety standards, ensure compliance and build a proactive safety culture across the plant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the site Health & Safety strategy, policies and improvement programmes.
  • Maintain effective Safety Management Systems, ensuring compliance with Irish legislation and ISO 45001 requirements.
  • Review and maintain risk assessments, safety statements, procedures and safe systems of work.
  • Lead incident investigations, identify trends and implement corrective and preventative actions.
  • Monitor H&S performance through audits, KPIs and management reporting.
  • Develop and deliver employee inductions, training and safety awareness programmes.
  • Partner with Production, Engineering, Quality and senior management to identify risks and implement practical improvements.
  • Promote employee engagement, safety ownership and continuous improvement across the site.

What We Are Looking For

  • A third-level qualification in Health & Safety or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience in a Health & Safety leadership role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Irish Health & Safety legislation and practical risk management.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining Safety Management Systems.
  • Knowledge of ISO 45001 and experience with auditing.
  • Proven leadership skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and challenge unsafe practices.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently and take full ownership of site safety.

What Is on Offer?

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Company pension.
  • Education assistance.
  • Sick pay.
  • Company events.
  • A standalone leadership role with responsibility for the full site H&S function.
  • The opportunity to shape safety culture and deliver meaningful improvements within an established manufacturing business.

Apply Today

If you are an experienced Health & Safety Manager with a strong manufacturing background and are ready to take ownership of site safety, apply today with your CV.

job.title: Office Administration Assistant
job.description:
Office Administration Assistant

Location: Wexford, County Wexford
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm

Full Job Description

About the Role

FRS Recruitment is working on behalf of our client, a growing company specialising in energy retrofit and home energy upgrades, to recruit an Office Administration Assistant for their team in Wexford.

This position will provide essential administrative support across the company's day-to-day operations, helping to ensure that customer enquiries, project documentation and retrofit jobs are managed efficiently.

The successful candidate will have strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and experience working with SEAI grant processes. They will be comfortable dealing with customers, maintaining accurate records and working closely with colleagues to keep projects progressing.

Key Responsibilities

Office Administration & Project Support

  • Provide general administrative support to the wider team.
  • Maintain accurate customer files, project records and company documentation.
  • Assist with scheduling, paperwork and the coordination of retrofit projects.
  • Monitor outstanding documents and follow up where information is required.
  • Support colleagues with daily administrative tasks and reporting.

SEAI Grants & Documentation

  • Assist with the administration of SEAI grant applications and supporting documentation.
  • Check customer information and paperwork for accuracy and completeness.
  • Track documentation and application progress, following up on outstanding requirements.
  • Liaise with customers and relevant internal teams regarding grant-related queries.
  • Keep up to date with relevant procedures and requirements to support accurate processing.

Customer Communication

  • Answer incoming calls and emails, dealing with enquiries in a professional manner.
  • Provide customers with updates and guidance on documentation requirements.
  • Direct queries to the appropriate team members where necessary.
  • Maintain clear records of customer communications and follow-up actions.
  • Deliver a helpful and professional customer service experience.

Systems & Record Management

  • Update the company's CRM system and internal databases.
  • Ensure information is recorded accurately and kept up to date.
  • Assist with spreadsheets, reports and general office systems.
  • Follow established procedures and identify opportunities to improve administrative processes.

About You

The ideal candidate will be organised, reliable and comfortable working in a busy office environment. They will be able to manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy and customer service.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in an office administration or administrative support role.
  • Previous experience with SEAI grants and related documentation is highly desirable.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Experience using CRM systems would be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.
  • Good time management and the ability to prioritise workloads.
  • A professional, proactive and team-focused approach.

Experience in the construction, energy retrofit, glazing or home improvement sector would be beneficial.

What We Offer

  • Full-time, permanent employment.
  • Company pension.
  • On-site parking.
  • The opportunity to join a growing business within the energy efficiency sector.

If you have strong administration skills and experience with SEAI grant processes, we would welcome your application.

job.title: Delivery Manager
job.description:
ABOUT TURAS NUA

At Turas Nua, we support people who are unemployed by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The Intreo Partner of National Employment Services (IPNES) contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is an Irish employability services provider, wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.

ABOUT DEPARTMENT

Our Operations Team support clients through a progression journey towards employment. Our teams provide one-to-one support to clients while coordinating interventions to tackle any barriers to employment.

PURPOSE OF ROLE

job.title: QC Validation Specialist
job.description:
Seeking a QC Validation Specialist !

This position plays a critical role in ensuring analytical methods are properly designed, validated and transferred in alignment with EU/FDA GMP requirements for advanced therapy products.

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have hands-on experience designing validation studies, as well as authoring and reviewing validation protocols and reports—not just executing test methods developed by others. A genuine understanding of the regulatory landscape and the rationale behind validation activities is essential.

The Role

In this position, you will:

  • Lead and support the development, validation and technology transfer of new and established analytical methods for gene therapy products.

  • Design validation studies and generate validation protocols, data analysis summaries and comprehensive reports.

  • Ensure analytical methods are fully validated and transferred into QC GMP laboratories in line with regulatory expectations (EU/FDA, ICH Q2(R1), GMP, data integrity).

  • Create, update and maintain method SOPs and technical documentation.

  • Provide clear communication and progress updates to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Conduct routine assessments of analytical methods to ensure continued control and suitability.

  • Support Quality Management System activities, including document control and data integrity oversight.

  • Maintain and track personal training, GMP compliance and document lifecycle responsibilities (deviations, CAPAs, change controls).

  • When required, perform analytical testing of gene therapy products according to approved specifications.

Candidate Profile

  • A degree or Master’s in a scientific discipline (e.g., Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry).

  • Approx. 2+ years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, biologics, or a similarly regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in method validation, including:

    • Designing validation studies,

    • Writing and reviewing protocols and validation reports,

    • A strong understanding of regulatory requirements and data integrity.

  • Experience with analytical techniques (advantageous but not essential): qPCR, HPLC (RP-HPLC/SEC), ELISA, SDS-PAGE/Western blot, cell culture, DNA extraction.

  • Strong understanding of ICH Q2(R1).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Keywords: QC Validation Chemist, Method Transfer Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist, Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist,Chemist, HPLC,GMP

job.title: Production Planner- Shannon
job.description:
My client, a leading manufacturer based in Shannon, Co. Clare, is looking to recruit an experienced Production Planner to join their busy and growing team.

Reporting to the Head of Production, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring production plans are delivered efficiently, customer requirements are met, and materials and resources are available when needed.

The Role

The Production Planner will be responsible for developing and maintaining the production schedule, balancing workloads and capacity while responding proactively to changing customer requirements, production priorities and operational constraints.

Working closely with teams across the business, including Customer Service, Purchasing, Warehouse, Quality and Production, you will help ensure the smooth flow of materials and products through the manufacturing process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain production schedules using an ERP system, ensuring customer requirements and operational priorities are met.
  • Plan and balance production workloads to maximise capacity, efficiency and on-time delivery.
  • Monitor production progress and adjust schedules in response to changing priorities, resource constraints or machine downtime.

  • Coordinate with Quality and Incoming Inspection to prioritise critical materials required for production.
  • Monitor Work in Progress (WIP), identifying potential bottlenecks and taking action to minimise delays.
  • Track outsourced processing activities and ensure supplier commitments align with production requirements.
  • Monitor production performance against schedule and highlight risks, constraints and opportunities for improvement.
  • Use ERP system data to support effective planning, decision-making and continuous improvement.

Requirements for the desired Production Planner include:

  • Previous experience in production planning, supply chain or a similar operations role, ideally within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong organisational and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while managing competing priorities.
  • Experience using an ERP system; Oracle/Oracle Access ERP experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to respond quickly to changing production requirements.

The business is undergoing significant expansion, including the construction of a new production facility and a major increase in manufacturing capacity. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead and manage the Quality function across all manufacturing operations, ensuring strong quality performance, product release and robust compliance systems.
  • Maintain effective traceability and batch record systems, ensuring accuracy, integrity and accessibility of records.
  • Lead regulatory and certification compliance, ensuring adherence to DAFM, HACCP, UFAS, NOPS, GMP+ and relevant customer and industry standards.
  • Manage the Quality Management System (QMS) and document control processes.
  • Develop and oversee the analytical testing programme, using HACCP and risk assessment principles.
  • Lead the internal audit programme and manage all external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring findings are addressed promptly.
  • Oversee supplier approval, raw material change control and cross-functional assessment of quality and regulatory impacts.
  • Manage the customer complaints process, ensuring effective investigation, corrective action and timely closure.
  • Lead non-conformance, root cause analysis and corrective action, driving continuous improvement across the site.
  • Monitor and trend key quality and site performance metrics, leading quality review meetings and follow-up actions.
  • Develop team capability through effective training, coaching and support.
  • Work closely with Operations, Technical, Commercial and other functions to deliver site objectives and maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience as a Quality Manager in a production processing environment
  • 10 years minimum experience in a pharma or food production environment.
  • Degree in a Science related subject
  • Level 5 or higher HACCP certification
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent understanding of Food Safety and Quality Management Systems, with strong knowledge of food/feed legislation, customer standards and Codes of Practice
  • Formal Audit Training / Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor experience

What's in it for you?

job.title: Psychologist - Paediatrics HYBRID
job.description:
Psychologist – Children’s Services (Open to both Full time and part time)
Hybrid | Wicklow

A well-established, multi award-winning children’s services provider is seeking a Psychologist to join its growing multidisciplinary team. The service is grounded in strong values, ethical practice and a genuinely family-centred approach, offering children and their families clarity, understanding and practical pathways forward.

The clinic places a strong emphasis on collaboration, reflective practice and creating a supportive environment where clinicians feel valued, listened to and professionally fulfilled.

The Role
The Psychologist will work with children and families as part of a warm, experienced multidisciplinary team. While autism assessment forms a key part of the role, the position is embedded within a service that prioritises thoughtful, ethical practice and positive family experience over volume-driven work.

Key Responsibilities
• Completing autism diagnostic assessments with children and young people
• Administration, scoring and interpretation of ADOS-2 and/or ADI-R
• Contributing to multidisciplinary formulation and shared clinical decision-making
• Preparing clear, compassionate and high-quality assessment and diagnostic reports
• Providing feedback to parents and caregivers in a supportive, respectful manner
• Working closely with Occupational Therapists and other clinicians
• Maintaining clinical records in line with PSI and professional standards

Hybrid Working
This is a hybrid role. On-site attendance is required to conduct assessments with children and families, while remote working is possible for report writing, administration and other non-assessment tasks. The balance of on-site and remote work will support both service delivery and clinician flexibility.

Essential Criteria
• Recognised qualification in Psychology
• PSI registration
• Minimum 1 year experience working with children and young people in an assessment context
• Formal training and experience in ADOS-2 and/or ADI-R (essential)
• Strong clinical formulation, communication and report-writing skills
• A collaborative, values-led approach to clinical work

What the Service Offers
• A supportive, clinician-led environment with strong values and culture
• Genuine MDT collaboration and shared learning
• Flexible hybrid working arrangements
• Administrative support that protects clinical time
• A thoughtful, ethical approach to assessment and family care

job.title: Farm Maintenance Mechanic Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

To apply

Please email your cv through the attached link

  • Recruit drivers through multiple channels including but not limited to; existing driver networks, alumni drivers, employee referrals, social media, recruitment agencies, driver training schools, apprenticeship programs, international recruitment initiatives, job boards and specialist transport recruitment platforms
  • Oversee the design, content and effectiveness of the company's driver recruitment website and related company digital recruitment platforms.
  • Manage all recruitment expenditure and operate within agreed budgets.
  • Establish partnerships with external training organisations and educational bodies and develop and manage internal driver apprenticeships and trainee programmes.
  • Manage and continuously improve driver referral bonus scheme.
  • Maximise recruitment conversion rates, reduce recruitment costs, and time invested through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Design and manage all driver screening and selection processes.
  • Develop selection criteria to ensure the recruitment of high-performing drivers who align with company values.
  • Coordinate Interviews, Assessments, driving evaluations, Qualification & Certifications Compliance and right to work employment checks and medical assessments where required
  • Manage candidate and business stakeholder expectations throughout the recruitment process.
  • Design, implement and manage structured onboarding programs.
  • Ensure probation reviews are completed for all drivers within 1 month, co-ordinate review & sign off for Head of Driver Management and transition successful candidates to Performance & Comp Lead.
  • Develop and execute the annual driver engagement plan with initiatives designed to improve recruitment conversion, reduce turnover, identify flight risks and improve employee satisfaction e.g. establish regular structured driver engagement (surveys, direct phone calls),
  • Develop and maintain a Driver Buddy Program to assist with onboarding and integration.
  • Develop and execute the company's driver-focused social media strategy.
  • Ensure driver feedback (concerns and suggestions) are collated and shared (with relevant staff promptly e.g. planning, garage or driver mgt team), concluded (actions / decision) and response (feedback / decisions) is provided.
  • Implement action plans to address driver attrition risks.
  • Monitor and analyse driver turnover trends and identify root causes by conducting stay interviews and exit interviews.

Skills / Qualifications:

  • 3+ years’ recruitment experience, with proven experience delivering multi-channel recruitment campaigns across job boards, websites and social media.
  • Experience recruiting international staff a bonus with navigating Irish immigration requirements, including employment permits, IRP permissions, visa requirements, and related work authorisation processes.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, with the ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy.
  • Proven track record in recruitment, retention, employee engagement and workforce planning, with a focus on delivering positive outcomes.
  • Strong IT, analytical and reporting skills, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and similar systems.
  • Experience managing budgets and delivering measurable operational improvements.
  • Highly organised, proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and demonstrate a willingness to learn and progress.
  • Experience in employer branding and social media recruitment.

job.title: Farm Maintenance Mechanic Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

To apply

job.title: Poultry Farm Manager
job.description:

  • Yearly Bonus based KPI system
  • Severance

Reporting to the HR Manager, this is an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic HR professional to provide HR support in a variety of areas from recruitment, training, employee relations, rostering and admin and project works. The successful candidate will provide best in class HR support, advice, and guidance to the business as part of the HR team.

Main Responsibilities:

Rostering and Scheduling

  • Responsibility for the weekly rostering and scheduling of all flexi employees (approx. 150 employees) for a 24/7 operation
  • This is a demanding yet fulfilling responsibility with operations relying on the ability of the HR Administrator to complete the daily and weekly rosters
  • Fully responsible for ensuring all production lines are manned with the relevant key skills and general operator man power requirements
  • Producing accurate and detailed daily and weekly reports reflecting the weekly schedules, linking in all relevant reports to include, absence management, key skill fulfilment, overtime analysis, labour compare and payroll adjustments

HR and Time and Attendance System (TMS)

  • Acting as the main point of contact for all staff remuneration and benefit issues.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Quality Manager-Cork

Excellent salary package + bonus, pension & healthcare

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

A well-established Cork based food manufacturer is continuing to expand its operations and is now seeking an experienced Quality Manager to join the team.

The business manufactures a wide range of nutritional products serving multiple sectors, with a strong focus on quality, food/feed safety, compliance and continuous improvement.

The business is undergoing significant expansion, including the construction of a new production facility and a major increase in manufacturing capacity. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead and manage the Quality function across all manufacturing operations, ensuring strong quality performance, product release and robust compliance systems.
  • Maintain effective traceability and batch record systems, ensuring accuracy, integrity and accessibility of records.
  • Lead regulatory and certification compliance, ensuring adherence to DAFM, HACCP, UFAS, NOPS, GMP+ and relevant customer and industry standards.
  • Manage the Quality Management System (QMS) and document control processes.
  • Develop and oversee the analytical testing programme, using HACCP and risk assessment principles.
  • Lead the internal audit programme and manage all external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring findings are addressed promptly.
  • Oversee supplier approval, raw material change control and cross-functional assessment of quality and regulatory impacts.
  • Manage the customer complaints process, ensuring effective investigation, corrective action and timely closure.
  • Lead non-conformance, root cause analysis and corrective action, driving continuous improvement across the site.
  • Monitor and trend key quality and site performance metrics, leading quality review meetings and follow-up actions.
  • Develop team capability through effective training, coaching and support.
  • Work closely with Operations, Technical, Commercial and other functions to deliver site objectives and maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience as a Quality Manager in a production processing environment
  • 10 years minimum experience in a pharma or food production environment.
  • Degree in a Science related subject
  • Level 5 or higher HACCP certification
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent understanding of Food Safety and Quality Management Systems, with strong knowledge of food/feed legislation, customer standards and Codes of Practice
  • Formal Audit Training / Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor experience

What's in it for you?

  • Excellent salary package DOE
  • Performance-related bonus
  • Pension
  • Healthcare
  • Opportunity to join a business undergoing significant expansion
  • Major investment in a new production facility
  • Opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

job.title: Senior Unit Manager - Dairy ( Saudi Arabia )
job.description:
Are you looking currently looking to travel abroad and gain great experience working on a large scale dairy farm ? If so this may be the role for you.

We are now accepting cvs for positions that will be starting from January 2027 on-wards.

In return my client is offering a lucrative tax free package which will include a basic salary & bonus. Salary in year 1 (€50000 to €54000). Accommodation and food provided , 98 days annual leave , access to gym sand sports facilities and further career progression opportunities.

If you possess 3 to 4 years practical milking experience from Ireland and now seeking to work on a larger scale dairy farm we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Overview

FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for Senior Unit Managers for a large dairy farm operation in the Middle East.Ideally my client is seeking applications from candidates whom can make a minimum commitment of 3-5 years.

My client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East which presently has 90,000 cows and rear 70,000 young stock in 6 modern dairy farms. The successful candidates for these roles will undergo a programme of on the job training in all aspects reflecting the best European standards.

FRS Recruitment which is part of the FRS Network has been serving the Irish agricultural trade since 1980. My client is particularly interested in seeking applications from candidates with hands on milking experience from Ireland & UK. If you have gained work experience through college on large scale dairy operations outside of Ireland and UK this would be a distinct advantage.

Core purpose of the role

To maximise production and thereby profit of the farm by planning and organising all farm functional activities within assigned areas of responsibility and making the most efficient use of all resources at this disposal.

Reporting to the Farm Manager you will be responsible for the following duties

  • Calving ; calve cows & heifers , feed colostrum and do daily recordings , vaccinations and record movements per calving
  • Feeding ; feeding heifers & bull calves from day old to weaning. Cows are fed 4 times per day
  • Health ; detect sick cows and diagnose and treat them
  • Breeding ; work closely with the breeding team and select cows that are unsuitable for re breeding.
  • Milking parlour ; test milk for quality and BF % & SNF %.

Candidate profile

  • 3rd level Degree or Cert required ( Minimum of Level 7 required )
  • 3 to 4 years practical experience working on Irish dairy farm
  • Work experience in Australia or New Zealand through college placement or other is a distinct advantage.
  • Career minded and highly motivated.

Remuneration

  • Starting salary of 50000 Euros + end or year bonus ( equivalent to 1 months salary ) - all tax free
  • 6 free flights to and from Ireland to Riyadh
  • 98 days annual leave
  • Accommodation & food provided
  • Access to gyms and very modern leisure facilities.
  • Further career progression

To apply

If you possess 3 to 4 years practical milking experience from Ireland and now seeking to work on a larger scale dairy farm we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Application by cv only , please submit cv through link at the bottom of job advert.

Interested candidates can call John directly on 087 9955439

* Please note - we do not accept cvs through whatsapp*

Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Manager

Co. Longford | Food Manufacturing | Competitive Salary

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced EHS Manager to take ownership of Environmental, Health & Safety across a busy, high-volume food manufacturing site in Co. Longford.

Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will lead the site EHS strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance while driving a strong, proactive safety culture and continuous environmental improvement.

The Role

You will have responsibility for:

  • Leading all EHS activities across the manufacturing site.
  • Ensuring compliance with Irish H&S legislation, EPA licence requirements and environmental regulations.
  • Managing the site's ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 systems.
  • Overseeing EPA Industrial Emissions licence compliance, environmental monitoring and statutory reporting.
  • Leading risk assessments, incident investigations, audits, contractor safety and permit-to-work systems.
  • Developing and delivering EHS training, toolbox talks and behavioural safety initiatives.
  • Managing environmental programmes covering waste, water, energy, emissions and carbon reduction.
  • Acting as the key site contact for the EPA, HSA, Irish Water and other regulatory bodies.
  • Monitoring EHS KPIs and providing regular performance reports to senior management.
  • Driving continuous improvement projects and developing a strong safety-first culture across all levels of the business.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in an EHS Manager / Senior EHS role, ideally within food manufacturing, FMCG or a similar high-volume production environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Irish Health & Safety and Environmental legislation.
  • Experience with EPA licence compliance and ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 systems.

Qualifications

A relevant degree or qualification in Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, along with professional qualifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH or equivalent.

Experience in sustainability, carbon reduction, ESG or environmental improvement projects would also be advantageous.

Why Consider This Role?

  • Senior EHS position with site-wide responsibility.
  • Direct reporting line to the General Manager.
  • Opportunity to shape and develop the site's EHS culture and strategy.
  • Significant scope to deliver environmental and continuous-improvement projects.
  • Established Irish food manufacturing business with a strong focus on people, quality and investment.
  • Generous package available.

job.title: Health and Safety Coordinator
job.description:
Health & Safety Coordinator

Location: Tipperary / Midlands
11-Month Fixed-Term Contract | Strong Potential for Permanency
Generous Salary Package

Our client, a well-established manufacturing company based in the Tipperary/Midlands region, is seeking an experienced Health & Safety Coordinator to join their team.

This is an initial 11-month fixed-term contract, with strong potential for a permanent position for the right candidate.

Reporting to the HR Manager, you will support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of the company's Health & Safety management systems across the site.

Working closely with management, supervisors and employees, you will play a key role in promoting a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with Irish Health & Safety legislation and maintaining a safe and proactive working environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of Health & Safety policies, procedures and systems.
  • Carry out regular workplace safety inspections and audits, identifying hazards and following up on corrective actions.
  • Assist with the preparation, review and maintenance of Risk Assessments, Safe Operating Procedures and Method Statements.
  • Monitor compliance with site Health & Safety procedures and escalate areas of concern where required.
  • Assist with the investigation of accidents, incidents, near misses and dangerous occurrences.
  • Identify root causes and recommend appropriate corrective and preventative actions.
  • Maintain accurate Health & Safety, accident and incident records.
  • Identify & coordinate Health & Safety training requirements across the business.
  • Support Health & Safety inductions for employees, contractors and visitors.
  • Deliver Manual Handling training as part of the new employee induction process and coordinate refresher training.
  • Assist with fire safety inspections, emergency drills and emergency preparedness activities.
  • Assist with the preparation of Health & Safety reports, statistics and performance updates.

About You

  • Relevant qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, ideally Level 6 or equivalent.
  • Previous experience in a Health & Safety role, preferably within a manufacturing, production or industrial environment.
  • Good knowledge of Irish Health & Safety legislation and workplace safety requirements.
  • Experience conducting risk assessments, workplace inspections and incident investigations.
  • Strong organisational, communication and administrative skills.
  • A proactive approach with the ability to work effectively with management and employees at all levels.

What's on Offer

  • Generous salary package.
  • Initial 11-month fixed-term contract with strong potential for permanency.
  • Opportunity to join a well-established manufacturing business.
  • Supportive leadership team and positive working environment.
  • Opportunity to make a real impact on the site's Health & Safety culture.
  • Immediate start available for the right candidate.

If you're a Health & Safety professional looking for your next opportunity within a manufacturing environment, I'd love to hear from you.

job.title: GP
job.description:
General Practitioner - Permanent post

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced GP seeking a leadership role within a progressive and expanding healthcare organisation committed to delivering exceptional patient care across primary care and nursing home settings.

The ideal candidate will come with extensive experience within the Irish healthcare system to lead the delivery of high-quality, patient-centred care across both the practice population and associated nursing home services. The successful candidate will play a key leadership role in the development and implementation of the practice's Chronic Disease Management (CDM) Programme and other HSE-funded and GMS initiatives.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the continued growth and strategic development of primary care services the Family Practice

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide comprehensive, evidence-based primary care services to GMS and private patients.
  • Deliver ongoing medical care and clinical oversight to residents in partner nursing homes.
  • Conduct scheduled nursing home visits and additional visits as clinically required.
  • Lead the practice's HSE Chronic Disease Management (CDM) Programme, ensuring achievement of programme targets and compliance requirements.
  • Support and implement HSE and GMS initiatives, including preventative care and chronic disease pathways.
  • Develop and manage patient-centred treatment plans for acute and chronic conditions.
  • Work collaboratively with nursing staff, allied health professionals, administrative teams and external healthcare providers.
  • Maintain accurate, timely and compliant clinical documentation.
  • Participate in clinical governance, quality improvement and audit activities.

Essential Requirements

Applicants must meet all of the following criteria:

  • Medical degree (MB BCh BAO, MBBS or equivalent).
  • Specialist Registration in General Practice with the Irish Medical Council.
  • Fully eligible to provide services under the General Medical Services (GMS) Scheme.
  • Minimum of five years' post-training experience working within Irish General Practice.
  • Demonstrated experience managing GMS patient populations.
  • Experience delivering or leading HSE Chronic Disease Management (CDM) Programmes.
  • Strong understanding of HSE primary care initiatives, GMS contracts and chronic disease pathways.
  • Excellent clinical, communication and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Full clean driving licence and access to own transport.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in nursing home medicine, elderly care and complex chronic disease management.
  • Experience leading service development and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Interest in population health management and integrated community care.

What We Offer

  • Full Medical Indemnity Insurance cover.
  • Annual Irish Medical Council registration fees paid by the organisation.
  • Ongoing support for the delivery and development of the HSE Chronic Disease Management (CDM) Programme.
  • Access to a broad range of clinical, operational and professional supports across the organisations network
  • Dedicated nursing and administrative support.
  • Continuing Professional Development (CPD) support and career development opportunities.
  • Supportive multidisciplinary working environment.
  • Travel allowance for nursing home and community visits.
  • Opportunity to play a significant leadership role in the continued growth and development of our Family Practice services.
  • On site parking
  • Company Pension
  • Sick Pay

job.title: Farm Machinery Assembly & Repairs
job.description:

Strong spare-parts knowledge is particularly important for this position. Key Responsibilities

  • Inspect machinery and components to identify wear, damage and potential problems.
  • Identify and source the correct spare parts and replacement components.
  • Use parts diagrams, manuals and technical information to identify components.
  • Maintain accurate records of repairs, servicing and parts used.
  • Prepare machinery for delivery, sale or return to customers.
  • Assist with the inspection and preparation of machinery coming into the business.
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop.
  • Work safely and follow appropriate workshop and company procedures.
  • Provide practical technical support to colleagues and customers where required.
  • Take ownership of jobs from diagnosis through to completion.

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience working with agricultural/farm machinery.
  • Strong mechanical and practical skills.
  • Proven experience in machinery assembly, servicing and repairs.
  • Good knowledge of agricultural machinery spare parts and components.
  • The ability to identify parts using diagrams, catalogues and technical information.
  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving abilities.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

job.title: Mechanical Inspection Engineer
job.description:
Mechanical Inspection Engineer

Location: Dublin, Meath or Louth
Salary: From €61,800

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced engineering professional to join a leading engineering inspection and examination provider.

The role involves carrying out inspections, examinations and reporting on a wide range of pressure equipment, helping customers maintain statutory compliance while supporting the safety of people, property and equipment.

You will work with customers across a variety of sectors, including local authorities, emergency services, education, dairy processing, pharmaceutical, brewing and general industry.

We are ideally looking for someone based in Dublin, Meath or Louth, although candidates in other Leinster locations may also be considered, as the workload is primarily focused across the province.

What Will You Be Doing?

As a Pressure Engineer Surveyor, you will be responsible for inspecting, testing and reporting on a variety of pressure equipment, ranging from air-conditioning units and coffee boilers to pressure vessels, safety valves and steam boilers.

Your role will be focused on delivering a high-quality inspection service, identifying potential safety issues and helping customers ensure their equipment meets the required standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out rigorous inspections and examinations of pressure equipment to identify defects and potential safety issues.
  • Inspect equipment including boilers, pressure vessels, heating systems, air-conditioning equipment, refrigeration systems and associated pressure equipment.
  • Complete detailed and accurate technical reports following inspections.
  • Identify and clearly communicate defects, safety concerns and required actions to customers.
  • Help customers maintain compliance with relevant statutory and industry requirements.
  • Manage an assigned workload and inspection schedule across your geographical area.
  • Deliver a professional and responsive service to customers.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections and examinations.
  • Work independently while having access to technical support when required.
  • Represent the organisation professionally when working at customer sites.

What We Are Looking For

To be considered for this opportunity, you should have:

  • An NVQ Level 4 engineering qualification, or equivalent qualification at the higher end of NFQ Level 6.
  • Substantial practical, hands-on engineering experience working with equipment such as boilers, pressure vessels, heating systems, air-conditioning units and/or refrigeration systems.
  • The ability to understand and assess technical engineering equipment and identify potential defects or safety concerns.
  • The ability to explain complex technical matters clearly and communicate safety issues to customers in a timely, professional and confident manner.
  • Strong written English and the ability to produce accurate, coherent and professional technical reports.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Confidence using modern IT devices such as tablets and smartphones.
  • A full clean driving licence.

The Person

This role would suit an experienced, practical engineer who enjoys combining technical engineering knowledge with independent field-based work and customer interaction.

You will need to be comfortable taking responsibility for your own workload, making sound technical assessments and communicating your findings clearly to customers.

Previous experience as an Engineer Surveyor would be highly beneficial, but candidates from hands-on maintenance, mechanical, pressure systems, boiler, HVAC or related engineering backgrounds who meet the technical requirements may also be well suited to the opportunity.

Successful candidates will be required to complete relevant background checks as part of the recruitment process.

Apply today, by sending your cv and I will contact you for a discussion.

Contact Eimar Galvin on 086 185 2313 or email egalvin@frsrecruitment for a confidential chat

Please note: due to current time constraints and travel restrictions, only candidates located in Ireland with full rights to work will be considered for this position.

By applying, you are giving consent for FRS Recruitment to contact you about this job. We collect your data for recruitment purposes only and will retain it for the duration required as outlined in our privacy policy. All CVs are kept confidential and will not be submitted to any clients without your knowledge and consent.

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
Automation Engineer

Dunboyne, Co. Meath

A leading provider of OT, SCADA, telemetry, and communications solutions is seeking an Automation Engineer.

Join a team delivering cutting‑edge technologies and high‑quality SCADA solutions.

Overview

This role is primarily office‑based, with occasional site visits during deployment and commissioning phases. A major focus of the position involves working with Ignition, a web‑based HMI, SCADA, and MES platform, to deliver a high‑quality front‑end SCADA solution to clients.

The role requires ongoing communication with clients throughout implementation, as well as post‑deployment support for system queries or issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Presales and design of new solutions and installations
  • Responding to customer and client requests as they arise
  • Liaising with Junior SCADA/Automation Engineers on PLC, HMI, and SCADA software implementation
  • Creating software design specifications and associated documentation
  • Using design tools such as InTouch, Ignition, Broadwin, and 1CC Flexible
  • Training clients on systems once implemented
  • Ensuring consistency of work across all projects
  • Working to project deadlines
  • Managing all files and licensing associated with projects
  • Interfacing with client IT departments regarding security
  • General housekeeping of all SCADA projects
  • Developing standards and specifications aligned with customer requirements
  • Creating standard libraries and productised solutions to improve efficiency in future project delivery
  • Producing work breakdown structures for your own projects and those of junior engineers

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong understanding of SCADA system architecture and components
  • Experience with SCADA platforms such as Ignition, Siemens WinCC, Wonderware, or similar
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, etc.)
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC, etc.)
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience developing SCADA and PLC solutions
  • Demonstrated experience in software development and solution design with Schneider PLCs or similar
  • Experience using AI technologies
  • Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Database Manager
  • Familiarity with remote access tools (PC Anywhere, Remote Desktop, TeamViewer)
  • Understanding of data science and statistics
  • Ability to work with VB and SQL
  • Knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, and related industrial networking protocols
  • Awareness of SCADA cybersecurity best practices
  • Experience designing and managing SCADA alarms

job.title: Contract Psychologist – Neurodevelopmental Assessments
job.description:
Contract Psychologist – Neurodevelopmental Assessments

Location: Dublin
Contract: Contract / Part-Time
Hours: Flexible
Rates: Excellent rates available

We are seeking an experienced Clinical, Counselling or Educational Psychologist to join a supportive, multidisciplinary team providing high-quality, evidence-based neurodevelopmental assessments to children, young people and families.

This is an excellent part-time contract opportunity offering flexible working arrangements and competitive rates, making it ideal for an experienced Psychologist looking for greater flexibility alongside other professional commitments.

You will play a key role in delivering comprehensive assessments across Autism, ADHD, Intellectual Disability and other neurodevelopmental presentations, working collaboratively with an experienced MDT and senior clinicians.

The Role

As a Contract Psychologist, you will be responsible for:

  • Conducting face-to-face structured observations as part of neurodevelopmental assessments.
  • Completing remote developmental history interviews with parents and carers.
  • Contributing to collaborative MDT diagnostic discussions with support from senior clinicians.
  • Providing clear, compassionate feedback to children, young people and families.
  • Preparing high-quality clinical reports and diagnostic formulations.
  • Applying your expertise in differential diagnosis and evidence-based practice.

What You Can Expect

  • Excellent contract rates
  • Part-time and flexible hours
  • Optimised Diary planning in line with your preferences
  • A supportive and highly collaborative multidisciplinary team
  • Access to innovative digital tools designed to reduce administration and support efficient report writing
  • Comprehensive onboarding and training on clinical systems
  • Dedicated IT and operational support
  • Opportunities to contribute to training, research and professional development initiatives
  • A values-led environment focused on clinical excellence, compassion and staff wellbeing

Requirements

We are looking for Psychologists with:

  • A recognised Level 8 Psychology qualification or equivalent.
  • A postgraduate professional qualification recognised by the Psychological Society of Ireland (PSI) in Clinical or Counselling Psychology, or an appropriate recognised qualification in Educational Psychology.
  • A minimum of 3 years' experience conducting diagnostic assessments for Autism, ADHD and/or other neurodevelopmental conditions.
  • Strong knowledge of DSM-5 diagnostic criteria and differential diagnosis.
  • Experience conducting cognitive and neurodevelopmental assessments.
  • Training and experience using diagnostic tools such as ADOS-2 and ADI-R.
  • Excellent clinical report-writing skills.
  • Strong communication skills and a compassionate approach when working with children, young people and families.
  • The ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Excellent organisation and time-management skills.
  • Eligibility to work in the Republic of Ireland.

An Excellent Flexible Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join a forward-thinking clinical service where you can focus on delivering high-quality psychological care while benefiting from flexible working, excellent contract rates and strong clinical support.

If you are an experienced Psychologist with a background in neurodevelopmental assessment and are interested in a flexible part-time contract in Dublin, I would be very interested in hearing from you.

Apply today by sending your CV for a confidential discussion with Emma Fenton - Client Relationship Manager at FRS Recruitment.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Quality Manager-Cork

Excellent salary package + bonus, pension & healthcare

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

A well-established Cork based food manufacturer is continuing to expand its operations and is now seeking an experienced Quality Manager to join the team.

The business manufactures a wide range of nutritional products serving multiple sectors, with a strong focus on quality, food/feed safety, compliance and continuous improvement.

The business is undergoing significant expansion, including the construction of a new production facility and a major increase in manufacturing capacity. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead and manage the Quality function across all manufacturing operations, ensuring strong quality performance, product release and robust compliance systems.
  • Maintain effective traceability and batch record systems, ensuring accuracy, integrity and accessibility of records.
  • Lead regulatory and certification compliance, ensuring adherence to DAFM, HACCP, UFAS, NOPS, GMP+ and relevant customer and industry standards.
  • Manage the Quality Management System (QMS) and document control processes.
  • Develop and oversee the analytical testing programme, using HACCP and risk assessment principles.
  • Lead the internal audit programme and manage all external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring findings are addressed promptly.
  • Oversee supplier approval, raw material change control and cross-functional assessment of quality and regulatory impacts.
  • Manage the customer complaints process, ensuring effective investigation, corrective action and timely closure.
  • Lead non-conformance, root cause analysis and corrective action, driving continuous improvement across the site.
  • Monitor and trend key quality and site performance metrics, leading quality review meetings and follow-up actions.
  • Develop team capability through effective training, coaching and support.
  • Work closely with Operations, Technical, Commercial and other functions to deliver site objectives and maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience as a Quality Manager in a production processing environment
  • 10 years minimum experience in a pharma or food production environment.
  • Degree in a Science related subject
  • Level 5 or higher HACCP certification
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent understanding of Food Safety and Quality Management Systems, with strong knowledge of food/feed legislation, customer standards and Codes of Practice
  • Formal Audit Training / Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor experience

What's in it for you?

  • Excellent salary package DOE
  • Performance-related bonus
  • Pension
  • Healthcare
  • Opportunity to join a business undergoing significant expansion
  • Major investment in a new production facility
  • Opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

Respiratory Clinical Nurse Specialist

Are you an experienced nurse with specialist expertise in respiratory care and a passion for developing high-quality, patient-centred services?

We are seeking an ambitious, innovative and highly motivated Respiratory Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) to establish and lead a new Respiratory Specialist Nursing Service within our acute private hospital.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced respiratory nurse to take a leading role in shaping and developing a specialist service from the ground up. Working alongside our established respiratory experts, the successful candidate will develop a patient-centred CNS service designed to enhance clinical outcomes, promote excellence in respiratory care and support the strategic development of respiratory services across the hospital.

Working collaboratively with Consultant Respiratory Physicians, Nursing Leadership, Allied Health Professionals and wider multidisciplinary teams, the Respiratory CNS will play a key role in developing and implementing evidence-based pathways of care for patients with a broad range of respiratory conditions.

These will include, but are not limited to:

  • Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)

  • Asthma

  • Bronchiectasis

  • Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)

  • Other acute and chronic respiratory conditions

The successful candidate will also contribute to patient optimisation, education, care coordination, clinical governance, quality improvement and the ongoing development of respiratory nursing practice.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

Applicants must demonstrate:

  • Current registration as a Registered General Nurse on the General Division of the Register maintained by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI).

  • A minimum of five years’ post-registration clinical experience.

  • At least two years’ recent experience in respiratory nursing or a relevant respiratory clinical specialty.

  • A Level 8 qualification in Nursing.

  • Evidence of ongoing continuing professional development (CPD) relevant to respiratory care.

  • Experience in service development, project management and/or quality improvement.

  • Completion of, or willingness to undertake, relevant education and professional development in Clinical Nurse Specialist practice.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

The following would be advantageous:

  • A Master’s degree in Nursing, Healthcare or a related discipline.

  • Nurse Prescribing qualification, or a willingness to undertake the qualification.

  • Experience in the development and delivery of comprehensive patient and family education programmes focused on respiratory illness, self-management and patient optimisation.

  • Experience in developing and implementing clinical pathways, protocols and evidence-based respiratory care programmes.

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and contribute to service innovation.

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the development of a new specialist respiratory nursing service, while working closely with an established multidisciplinary respiratory team.

job.title: Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Manager
job.description:
Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Manager

Co. Longford | Food Manufacturing | Competitive Salary

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced EHS Manager to take ownership of Environmental, Health & Safety across a busy, high-volume food manufacturing site in Co. Longford.

Reporting directly to the General Manager, you will lead the site EHS strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance while driving a strong, proactive safety culture and continuous environmental improvement.

The Role

You will have responsibility for:

  • Leading all EHS activities across the manufacturing site.
  • Ensuring compliance with Irish H&S legislation, EPA licence requirements and environmental regulations.
  • Managing the site's ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 systems.
  • Overseeing EPA Industrial Emissions licence compliance, environmental monitoring and statutory reporting.
  • Leading risk assessments, incident investigations, audits, contractor safety and permit-to-work systems.
  • Developing and delivering EHS training, toolbox talks and behavioural safety initiatives.
  • Managing environmental programmes covering waste, water, energy, emissions and carbon reduction.
  • Acting as the key site contact for the EPA, HSA, Irish Water and other regulatory bodies.
  • Monitoring EHS KPIs and providing regular performance reports to senior management.
  • Driving continuous improvement projects and developing a strong safety-first culture across all levels of the business.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in an EHS Manager / Senior EHS role, ideally within food manufacturing, FMCG or a similar high-volume production environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Irish Health & Safety and Environmental legislation.
  • Experience with EPA licence compliance and ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 systems.

Qualifications

A relevant degree or qualification in Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, along with professional qualifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH or equivalent.

Experience in sustainability, carbon reduction, ESG or environmental improvement projects would also be advantageous.

Why Consider This Role?

  • Senior EHS position with site-wide responsibility.
  • Direct reporting line to the General Manager.
  • Opportunity to shape and develop the site's EHS culture and strategy.
  • Significant scope to deliver environmental and continuous-improvement projects.
  • Established Irish food manufacturing business with a strong focus on people, quality and investment.
  • Generous package available.

job.title: Production Manager
job.description:
Production Manager | Midlands

The Opportunity

An established and highly regarded Midlands-based manufacturing company is seeking an experienced Production Manager to join its leadership team. With over 45 years in operation, the business supplies OEM customers across Europe and has built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Reporting directly to the GM, you will lead the production function within a modern manufacturing facility focused on assembly, testing, and distribution activities.

Key Responsibilities

As Production Manager you will be responsible for:

  • Leading and coordinating all day-to-day production & warehouse operations.
  • Managing, motivating, and developing production teams to achieve operational objectives.
  • Ensuring production schedules are delivered in line with customer demand and business requirements.
  • Monitoring key performance indicators and implementing initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and quality.
  • Driving continuous improvement and Lean manufacturing activities across the operation.
  • Collaborating closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Managing workforce planning, training, performance management, and employee development.
  • Supporting operational excellence initiatives and identifying opportunities for process optimisation.

Candidate Requirements

As Production Manager you will possess:

  • You must have a degree qualification in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations etc or a trades background along with 3+ years production mgt experience
  • Excellent leadership, people management, and team development skills.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing & C I methodologies and experience using SAP or similar ERP systems

What's on Offer

  • Salary: €60,000 – €70,000
  • Pension contribution of 7.5% of pensionable salary & life assurance
  • Generous contribution to your Healthcare , including family cover

Interested?

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Production Manager to join a successful manufacturing business with a strong culture of continuous improvement and employee development.

job.title: Construction Estimator
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for an Estimator on behalf of a well-established Main Contractor based in Co. Offaly.

Working as part of an established and large commercial team, the successful candidate will be involved in the preparation and management of tenders across a highly varied portfolio of construction projects.

Our client delivers projects throughout the Midlands, alongside larger-scale developments across Dublin and Leinster. Their portfolio provides excellent variety, ranging from retail and commercial developments to educational, healthcare, heritage and high end construction projects.

This would particularly suit an Estimator with 3+ years' experience with a Main Contractor in Ireland or the UK, looking to join an established commercial team with strong opportunities for long-term career development.

The position will initially be primarily office-based in Co. Offaly, with hybrid working arrangements open for consideration following a successful onboarding period.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare detailed estimates for building and construction projects.
  • Review drawings, specifications and tender documentation thoroughly.
  • Complete accurate quantity take-offs and cost assessments.
  • Obtain and evaluate subcontractor and supplier quotations.
  • Prepare competitive tender submissions within required deadlines.
  • Identify commercial risks and opportunities during tender preparation.
  • Liaise closely with commercial, construction and management teams.
  • Support tender handovers following successful project awards.

Requirements

  • Minimum three years' estimating experience within construction.
  • Main Contractor experience within Ireland or the UK.
  • Strong understanding of construction methods, materials and costs.
  • Comfortable reviewing drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
  • Excellent numerical, analytical and commercial decision-making abilities.
  • Strong communication skills when dealing with subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Able to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines.
  • Relevant construction or Quantity Surveying qualification highly advantageous.

Salary & Benefits

  • €57,000 – €80,000 salary, depending on experience.
  • Overall package negotiable depending on candidate experience.
  • Hybrid working can be considered following initial onboarding.
  • Excellent long-term career development and progression opportunities.
  • Continuous professional development and technical training opportunities.
